candidates.raw_title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07919899 'EXTENSA' -- Sanofi/Regeneron Phase 3 study of SC dupilumab coformulated with berahyaluronidase alfa (ALT-B4) vs. approved SC Dupixent
candidates.gate_e: Direct reformulation of the tracker's Dupixent benchmark using Alteogen's ALT-B4, now at Phase 3 -- a successful Q4W readout would be the first concentration/dosing-frequency upgrade to the reference product itself.

candidates.raw_title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07792941 -- Pfizer Phase 1 PK study of tilrekimig (PF-07275315) co-mixed with rHuPH20 (ENHANZE), SC injection
